authors: Alain Bensoussan, Jacques-Louis Lions, George Papanicolaou
title: Asymptotic Analysis for Periodic Structures
venue: North-Holland, Studies in Mathematics and its Applications 5 (reprinted AMS Chelsea Publishing, 2011)
annotation: The standard reference for two-scale expansions and correctors in elliptic and parabolic equations with rapidly varying coefficients, including the probabilistic treatment of diffusions in periodic and random media on which the site's corrector calculation is modelled; the DOI is for the 2011 AMS Chelsea reprint.

authors: George C. Papanicolaou, Daniel W. Stroock, S. R. Srinivasa Varadhan
title: Martingale approach to some limit theorems
venue: Papers from the Duke Turbulence Conference (Durham, NC, 1976), Duke University Mathematics Series III, Duke University
annotation: Proves diffusion limits for processes driven by fast ergodic Markov noise via the martingale problem, supplying the Poisson-equation and perturbed test function arguments that justify replacing the fast regime by its average.

authors: R. Z. Khas'minskii
title: A Limit Theorem for the Solutions of Differential Equations with Random Right-Hand Sides
venue: Theory of Probability and Its Applications 11(3):390-406
annotation: Establishes the averaging and diffusion-approximation limit for differential equations driven by rapidly mixing random coefficients, the prototype for letting the regime chain switch at rate 1/epsilon.

authors: Thomas G. Kurtz
title: A limit theorem for perturbed operator semigroups with applications to random evolutions
annotation: Gives an operator-semigroup limit theorem for singularly perturbed generators of the form (1/epsilon)Q + L, which covers random evolutions such as an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process modulated by a fast Markov chain.

authors: Grigorios A. Pavliotis, Andrew M. Stuart
title: Multiscale Methods: Averaging and Homogenization
annotation: A textbook treatment of formal multiscale expansions for Markov chains, ODEs, SDEs and PDEs, including a chapter on averaging for Markov chains that matches the site's two-state switching setting.

authors: M. I. Freidlin, A. D. Wentzell
title: Random Perturbations of Dynamical Systems
annotation: Develops the averaging principle and associated large deviations for systems with fast and slow components, which describe the leading-order behaviour and rare-event corrections beyond the site's power-series expansion in epsilon.

authors: G. George Yin, Qing Zhang
title: Continuous-Time Markov Chains and Applications: A Singular Perturbation Approach
venue: Springer, Applications of Mathematics 37 (2nd ed. 2013, doi 10.1007/978-1-4614-4346-9)
annotation: Constructs asymptotic expansions, with outer and initial-layer terms, for probability distributions of Markov chains with generators of the form Q/epsilon, the general machinery behind expanding in the inverse switching rate.

authors: R. Z. Khasminskii, G. Yin
title: Asymptotic Series for Singularly Perturbed Kolmogorov-Fokker-Planck Equations
annotation: Derives full asymptotic series with error bounds for Kolmogorov-Fokker-Planck equations of diffusions with fast and slow components.

authors: A. M. Il'in, R. Z. Khasminskii, G. Yin
title: Asymptotic Expansions of Solutions of Integro-Differential Equations for Transition Densities of Singularly Perturbed Switching Diffusions: Rapid Switchings
venue: Journal of Mathematical Analysis and Applications 238(2):516-539
annotation: Obtains asymptotic expansions of the transition densities of diffusions whose coefficients are modulated by a rapidly switching Markov chain, the density-level analogue of the site's expansion for a Markov-modulated Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process.

authors: Gang Huang, Michel Mandjes, Peter Spreij
title: Weak convergence of Markov-modulated diffusion processes with rapid switching
annotation: Proves that a diffusion whose drift and diffusion coefficients are modulated by a rapidly switching Markov chain converges weakly to the diffusion with averaged coefficients, which is the leading-order statement underlying the site's averaged Vasicek limit.

authors: Gang Huang, H. M. Jansen, Michel Mandjes, Peter Spreij, Koen De Turck
title: Markov-modulated Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes
annotation: Computes moments and Laplace-transform PDEs of an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process with Markov-modulated parameters and proves functional central limit theorems when the modulating chain is accelerated, which is exactly the site's state process studied as a process rather than through its exponential functional.

authors: Gang Huang, Michel Mandjes, Peter Spreij
title: Large deviations for Markov-modulated diffusion processes with rapid switching
annotation: Proves a joint sample-path large deviations principle for a Markov-modulated diffusion and the chain's occupation measure under rapid switching and small noise.

authors: Jean-Pierre Fouque, George Papanicolaou, K. Ronnie Sircar
title: Derivatives in Financial Markets with Stochastic Volatility
annotation: Introduces fast mean-reverting stochastic volatility asymptotics in which prices are expanded around an effective constant-volatility model with a first-order correction, the template the site transfers to a fast regime chain.

authors: Jean-Pierre Fouque, George Papanicolaou, Ronnie Sircar, Knut Sølna
title: Multiscale Stochastic Volatility for Equity, Interest Rate, and Credit Derivatives
annotation: Extends the fast and slow scale expansions to interest rate and credit models, including Vasicek and CIR bond prices and defaultable bonds with stochastic intensity. It is the closest book-length treatment of the problem on this site, with a diffusive fast factor instead of a Markov chain.

authors: Peter Cotton, Jean-Pierre Fouque, George Papanicolaou, Ronnie Sircar
title: Stochastic Volatility Corrections for Interest Rate Derivatives
annotation: Derives the corrections to Vasicek and CIR bond prices when the volatility of the short rate is driven by a fast mean-reverting factor. The regime-switching expansion on this site is the same calculation with a two-state chain in place of the diffusion.

authors: Jean-Pierre Fouque, George Papanicolaou, Ronnie Sircar, Knut Sølna
title: Multiscale Stochastic Volatility Asymptotics
annotation: Combines a fast and a slow volatility factor in a joint singular and regular perturbation expansion of option prices.

authors: Jean-Pierre Fouque, George Papanicolaou, Ronnie Sircar, Knut Sølna
title: Singular Perturbations in Option Pricing
annotation: Gives the error analysis that justifies the first-order fast-scale correction for option prices, including nonsmooth payoffs.

authors: Rafael DeSantiago, Jean-Pierre Fouque, Knut Sølna
title: Bond markets with stochastic volatility
venue: Advances in Econometrics 22 (Econometrics and Risk Management):215-242
annotation: Computes fast and slow stochastic volatility corrections to Vasicek and CIR bond prices, again with a diffusive volatility factor where the site uses a two-state chain.

authors: Oldrich Vasicek
title: An equilibrium characterization of the term structure
annotation: Introduces the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck short rate and its exponential-affine bond price, which is the model obtained in each regime and in the averaged limit.

authors: John C. Cox, Jonathan E. Ingersoll Jr., Stephen A. Ross
title: A Theory of the Term Structure of Interest Rates
annotation: Introduces the square-root short rate model with exponential-affine bond prices, the natural alternative regime dynamics when positivity of the hazard rate is required.

authors: Darrell Duffie, Rui Kan
title: A Yield-Factor Model of Interest Rates
annotation: Characterizes the multifactor affine term structure models in which bond prices are exponential-affine with coefficients solving Riccati equations.

authors: James D. Hamilton
title: A New Approach to the Economic Analysis of Nonstationary Time Series and the Business Cycle
annotation: Introduces the Markov-switching time series model and its filter, the econometric origin of regime-switching interest rate and credit models.

authors: Camilla Landén
title: Bond pricing in a hidden Markov model of the short rate
annotation: Studies a short rate whose drift and diffusion parameters are modulated by a possibly unobserved Markov process, introduces semi-affine term structures, gives a closed-form bond price when the chain has two states, and studies a Vasicek extension numerically.

authors: Asbjørn T. Hansen, Rolf Poulsen
title: A simple regime switching term structure model
annotation: Proposes a short-rate model with Markov regime switching in the parameters and studies its term structure, appearing in the same issue as Landén (2000).

authors: Robert J. Elliott, Rogemar S. Mamon
title: An interest rate model with a Markovian mean reverting level
annotation: Takes a Vasicek short rate whose mean-reversion level is driven by a finite-state Markov chain and gives the bond price analytically through a fundamental matrix. It is the exact solution of the model on this site in the case of equal volatilities.

authors: Andrew Ang, Geert Bekaert
title: Regime Switches in Interest Rates
venue: Journal of Business and Economic Statistics 20(2):163-182
annotation: Estimates regime-switching short-rate models on US, UK and German data and documents that regimes capture nonlinearities in drift and volatility.

authors: Ravi Bansal, Hao Zhou
title: Term Structure of Interest Rates with Regime Shifts
annotation: Builds a discrete-time affine term structure model with regime shifts using log-linear approximations and finds that regime shifts improve the fit to yields.

authors: Shu Wu, Yong Zeng
title: A General Equilibrium Model of the Term Structure of Interest Rates under Regime-Switching Risk
venue: International Journal of Theoretical and Applied Finance 8(7):839-869
annotation: Develops an equilibrium term structure model with priced regime-shift risk and obtains closed-form affine yields under a log-linear approximation.

authors: Robert J. Elliott, Tak Kuen Siu
title: On Markov-modulated Exponential-affine Bond Price Formulae
annotation: Proves Markov-modulated exponential-affine bond price formulae for regime-switching Hull-White and CIR short rates, with coefficients given by fundamental matrix solutions of linear matrix differential equations, which contains the site's exact reduction as a special case.

authors: Misha van Beek, Michel Mandjes, Peter Spreij, Erik Winands
title: Regime switching affine processes with applications to finance
annotation: Shows that an affine process with Markov-switching parameters is affine on the enlarged state space, so transforms reduce to ODE systems, unifying earlier semi-analytic regime-switching bond formulas.

authors: Marianito R. Rodrigo, Rogemar S. Mamon
title: Bond pricing formulas for Markov-modulated affine term structure models
venue: Journal of Industrial and Management Optimization 17(5):2685ff
annotation: Gives exact and approximate zero-coupon bond formulas for Markov-modulated affine short rates with time-dependent coefficients and validates them on a regime-switching Vasicek model.

authors: G. Yin
title: Asymptotic expansions of option price under regime-switching diffusions with a fast-varying switching process
annotation: Develops uniform asymptotic expansions, with averaged Black-Scholes leading term and full series, for European option prices when the regime chain switches fast, the closest published analogue of the site's expansion but for equity options rather than bond prices.

authors: David D. Yao, Qing Zhang, Xun Yu Zhou
title: A Regime-Switching Model for European Options
venue: in Stochastic Processes, Optimization, and Control Theory (H. Yan, G. Yin, Q. Zhang, eds.), Springer, International Series in Operations Research and Management Science, pp. 281-300
annotation: Prices European options in a Black-Scholes model with Markov-switching parameters by successive approximation of the coupled pricing system.

authors: Arnab Basu, Mrinal K. Ghosh
title: Asymptotic analysis of option pricing in a Markov modulated market
annotation: Analyzes Markov-modulated option prices in the limits where the chain moves very fast or very slowly relative to the asset.

authors: Andrew Papanicolaou, Ronnie Sircar
title: A regime-switching Heston model for VIX and S&P 500 implied volatilities
annotation: Adds Markov regime switching to Heston stochastic volatility to fit VIX and S&P 500 option smiles jointly, an equity counterpart of combining a regime chain with an affine factor.

authors: David Lando
title: On Cox Processes and Credit Risky Securities
annotation: Models default as the first jump of a Cox process so that survival probabilities take the form E[exp(-integral of the intensity)], the object the site computes for a regime-switching intensity.

authors: Darrell Duffie, Kenneth J. Singleton
title: Modeling Term Structures of Defaultable Bonds
annotation: Shows that defaultable bonds can be priced by discounting at a default-adjusted short rate, so the site's survival probability and bond price calculations are the same computation.

authors: Darrell Duffie, Jun Pan, Kenneth Singleton
title: Transform Analysis and Asset Pricing for Affine Jump-Diffusions
annotation: Gives the general exponential-affine transform formula for affine jump-diffusions via Riccati ODEs, the framework within which regime switching is accommodated by enlarging the state space.

authors: R. Duncan Luce
title: Individual Choice Behavior: A Theoretical Analysis
annotation: Axiomatizes probabilistic choice through the choice axiom, yielding the ratio-scale choice model used elsewhere in the author's program.

authors: Vladimir Vovk, Alex Gammerman, Glenn Shafer
title: Algorithmic Learning in a Random World
annotation: Develops conformal prediction, giving distribution-free prediction sets with guaranteed coverage under exchangeability.
